gloss: waters; water area; body of water

definitions.gloss: waters; water area; body of water
definitions.explanation: A defined area or expanse of water, whether a river, lake, ocean, or other waterway. Often used in official, environmental, and regulatory contexts.

examples.japanese: この{水域|すいいき}は{遊泳|ゆうえい}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Swimming is prohibited in this water area.

examples.japanese: {汚染|おせん}された{水域|すいいき}の{浄化|じょうか}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Cleanup of the polluted waters is underway.

examples.japanese: {港|みなと}の{周辺|しゅうへん}{水域|すいいき}では{大型|おおがた}{船舶|せんぱく}の{航行|こうこう}が{制限|せいげん}されている。
examples.english: Navigation of large vessels is restricted in the waters around the port.

notes:
A compound of {水|すい} (water) and {域|いき} (area, zone). This is a somewhat formal and technical term used in environmental science, maritime regulation, and geography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉鎖|へいさ}{水域|すいいき}: enclosed waters (bay, lake)
- {沿岸|えんがん}{水域|すいいき}: coastal waters
- {内陸|ないりく}{水域|すいいき}: inland waters
- {水域|すいいき}{汚染|おせん}: water area pollution
- {保護|ほご}{水域|すいいき}: protected waters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {海域|かいいき}: sea area, maritime zone — specifically ocean/sea areas
- {領海|りょうかい}: territorial waters — a legal term for sovereign sea territory
- {流域|りゅういき}: river basin, watershed — the area drained by a river system
